source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Σιλβέστρος Πατριάρχης»

attestations.note: The whole of the page is a citation: «Η μνήμη του Αγίου Σιλβέστρου αναφέρεται στο Ιεροσολυμιτικό Κανονάριο σελ. 36 ως έξης: „Ἐν τὴ Ἀναστάσει, τοῦ ἁγίου πατριάρχου Σιλβέστρου“». It adds that his festival was held in the church of the Anastasis, and that of which city Sylvester was Patriarch — the one whose memory the church of Jerusalem keeps — is not known. The rank this folder carries is that manuscript's word and nothing more. The same Greek day keeps a martyr Sylvester on a page of his own; two entries on one calendar are two commemorations, and nothing on either page connects them.
